loop.zh: 今天的同行对象，是明天的同行者。

stages.companion_en: Help them see their unique experience and conviction, not just their scores.
stages.companion_zh: 帮他看见自己独特的经历和信念，而不只是分数。
stages.pain_en: Will AI make me obsolete before I start? Which major, which path?
stages.pain_zh: AI 会不会让我还没开始就被淘汰？选什么专业、哪条路？

stages.companion_en: Walk the first year with them: adjusting, courses, the first project, the first failure.
stages.companion_zh: 第一年有人同行：适应、选课、第一个项目、第一次失败。
stages.pain_en: I got in, and now I'm more anxious: everyone here seems stronger.
stages.pain_zh: 进了名校/大厂，反而更焦虑：周围人都比我强。
stages.who_en: students in admission season, new hires
stages.who_zh: 录取季的学生、拿到 offer 的新人

stages.companion_en: One honest conversation a month, plus one next step that can be checked.
stages.companion_zh: 每月一次真话对话 + 一个可以检验的下一步。
stages.pain_en: How do I grow skill and leadership? What is worth learning when AI keeps changing?
stages.pain_zh: 专业能力和领导力怎么长？AI 时代学什么才不白学？
stages.who_en: students, graduate students, first three years at work
stages.who_zh: 在读学生、研究生、职场前三年

stages.companion_en: The alumni network opens doors: referrals, cofounders, first users.
stages.companion_zh: 校友网络开门：内推、合伙人、第一批用户。
stages.pain_en: A job or a venture? How do I live outside the big-company story?
stages.pain_zh: 就业还是创业？大公司的叙事之外，我还能怎么活？

stages.companion_en: Become the next person's companion: the flywheel completes one turn.
stages.companion_zh: 成为下一个人的同行者：飞轮转完一圈。
stages.pain_en: I made it through. How do I help the next person?
stages.pain_zh: 我走过来了，怎么帮下一个人少走弯路？
stages.who_en: anyone who has walked the first four stages

rules.en: Faith is an invitation, never pressure. Never claim to know God's will for someone. Respect every belief and unbelief.
rules.zh: 信仰是邀请，从不施压。不替任何人宣称"神的旨意"。尊重每个人的信仰和不信。

rules.en: For self-harm, depression or a health crisis, refer at once to qualified help (local emergency number, campus counselling, a doctor). A companion is not a therapist.
rules.zh: 遇到自伤、抑郁、身体危机，立刻转介专业帮助（当地急救电话、学校心理中心、医生）。同行者不是治疗师。

rules.en: A seeker under 18 must have an informed parent or guardian, who knows when and with whom any one-to-one online conversation happens.
rules.zh: 未满 18 岁的同行对象，必须有一位知情的父母或监护人；线上一对一对话须让监护人知道时间和对象。

rules.en: Repo and circle files use pseudonyms plus year/field only. Never real names, phone numbers, emails, WeChat ids or ID numbers.
rules.zh: 仓库和圈子文件里只用化名和年级/领域，不写真名、电话、邮箱、微信号、身份证号。

rules.en: Every conversation ends with one written next step that can be checked.
rules.zh: 每次对话都以一个写下来、可检验的下一步结束。

rules.en: Companionship is free, sells nothing, and refers to no paid agents. Refer only people you actually know.
rules.zh: 同行不收费、不推销、不介绍有偿中介。内推只推荐你真正了解的人。

rules.en: A circle is a volunteer alumni group and does not represent any university or company.
rules.zh: 圈子是校友自发组织，不代表任何大学或公司。

autonomy.en: Each school's hive runs itself: its own people, data, site and rhythm.
autonomy.zh: 每个学校的蜂巢独立运营：自己的人、自己的数据、自己的网站、自己的节奏。

clock.en: One clock for every hive: calendar quarters, YYYY-S1 (Jan-Mar) to YYYY-S4 (Oct-Dec). Each hive publishes its public feed at least once a season (the heartbeat).
clock.zh: 联盟用同一个时钟：日历季度，YYYY-S1（1–3 月）到 YYYY-S4（10–12 月）。每个蜂巢每季至少发布一次公开 feed（心跳）。

exit.en: Any hive may fork and leave at any time, with all of its data.
exit.zh: 任何蜂巢随时可以分叉（fork）离开，带走自己的全部数据。

shared.en: The charter (this file), how the North Star is computed, and the open-source code.
shared.zh: 宪章（本文件）、北极星的计算方法、开源代码。

vote.en: Changing the charter needs 2/3 of registered hives, one hive one vote.
vote.zh: 修改宪章需 2/3 的在册蜂巢同意，一巢一票。

north_star.en: Every student, every season, is the CEO of something they love, while coaching others and being coached.
north_star.zh: 每一个学生，每一季都是某件自己热爱之事的 CEO，同时也在辅导别人、被别人辅导。

philosophy.en: Everyone has a calling and worth that no technology changes. AI is an amplifier, not a replacement.
philosophy.zh: 每个人都有呼召和价值，不因任何技术而改变。AI 是放大器，不是替代者。

philosophy.en: We are companions, not only door-openers: spirit, mind, heart and strategy, walked together.
philosophy.zh: 我们是同行者，不只是开门人：灵、智、情、策，四个方面一起走。

philosophy.en: One person plays different roles in different cells: advisor, core teammate, apprentice. Roles flow with your stage; none is fixed.
philosophy.zh: 同一个人在不同的蜂房里扮演不同角色：顾问、核心队员、学徒。角色随阶段流动，不固定。

philosophy.en: At any time, you are the CEO of something you have a vision and a conviction for.
philosophy.zh: 任何时候，你都是某件你有异象、有信念之事的 CEO。

principles.en: A cell = 1 CEO + 2-3 advisors + 2-3 core teammates + 2-3 apprentices, for one season (about 3 months).
principles.zh: 一个蜂房 = 1 位 CEO + 2–3 位顾问 + 2–3 位核心队员 + 2–3 位学徒，一季（约 3 个月）为期。

principles.en: Write what success looks like before acting. Every cell has a one-line vision and one checkable success criterion.
principles.zh: 先写"怎样算成功"，再开始做。每个蜂房有一句异象和一条可检验的成功标准。

principles.en: When a season ends, the result says what was observed, not what was hoped.
principles.zh: 一季结束，结果要写"看到了什么"，不写"希望什么"。

principles.en: Every check-in ends with one written next step that can be checked.
principles.zh: 每次碰头都以一个写下来、可检验的下一步结束。

principles.en: One person holds at most 3 roles a season, and at most 1 CEO role. Passion must be sustainable.
principles.zh: 一个人一季最多 3 个角色，最多 1 个 CEO 角色。热情要能持续。

principles.en: Minors have an informed guardian; data uses pseudonyms only; crises go to qualified help; faith is an invitation, never pressure.
principles.zh: 未成年人有知情的监护人；数据只用化名；危机转介专业帮助；信仰是邀请，从不施压。

principles.en: Share learnings, never people. Every closed cell records tags and what it learned, published to the federation as a learning card; rosters never leave the school.
principles.zh: 分享学到的，不分享人。每个结束的蜂房都写下标签和“学到了什么”，作为学习卡片发给联盟；名单永远留在本校。

principles.en: No fees, no selling, no tokens.

amplifier.en: Do the same work faster: AI is your tool.
amplifier.zh: 同样的事做得更快：AI 是你的工具。

amplifier.en: Turn your experience into a small product or service for a hundred people with your pain.
amplifier.zh: 把你的经历做成一个小产品或服务，帮到一百个和你有同样痛点的人。

amplifier.en: Build it with others: your conviction becomes their starting point.
amplifier.zh: 带一群人一起做：你的信念成为别人的起点。

levels.hint_en: Don't plan yet. First, tell one person the truth.
levels.hint_zh: 先别急着规划，先找一个人说真话。

levels.hint_en: You're already looking for a way. A companion makes this step shorter.
levels.hint_zh: 你已经在找路了，一位同行者能让这一步变短。

levels.hint_en: The ground is there. Next: amplify it, and bring one person with you.
levels.hint_zh: 根基在。下一步是把它放大，并带上一个人。

levels.hint_en: You could be someone else's companion now.
levels.hint_zh: 你可以成为别人的同行者了。

questions.en: I believe my worth does not depend on whether AI can replace my work.
questions.zh: 我相信我的价值不取决于 AI 能不能替代我的工作。

questions.en: I roughly know which people I want to solve which problem for in my life.
questions.zh: 我大概知道，我这一生想为哪一群人解决什么问题。

questions.en: This month I used AI to make something I could not have made before.
questions.zh: 这个月我用 AI 做出过一个以前做不出来的东西。

questions.en: I can name one experience others don't have, and one thing it taught me.
questions.zh: 我能说出一段别人没有的经历，以及它教会我的一件事。

questions.en: When I think about the future, I can still sleep and eat most of the time.
questions.zh: 想到未来时，我大多数时候睡得着、吃得下。

questions.en: There is at least one person I can tell my real fear to.
questions.zh: 有至少一个人，我可以对他说出我真正的害怕。

questions.en: I know which door is next for me (school, a job, or a venture).
questions.zh: 我知道我面前的下一扇门是哪一扇（升学、求职或创业）。

questions.en: I have written one next step I can do this week and check when it's done.
questions.zh: 我写下了一个这周就能做、做完能被检验的下一步。

dimensions.companion_en: Help them believe everyone has a calling and worth that no technology changes. Faith is an invitation, never pressure.
dimensions.companion_zh: 帮他相信：每个人都有呼召和价值，不因任何技术而改变。信仰是邀请，从不强加。
dimensions.question_en: Who am I, and why am I here?
dimensions.question_zh: 我是谁？我为什么在这里？

dimensions.companion_en: Connect one real skill to AI tools together, and make one thing they can show someone.
dimensions.companion_zh: 一起把一项真实技能和 AI 工具接起来，做出一个能给人看的东西。
dimensions.question_en: What can I do, and how far can AI multiply it?
dimensions.question_zh: 我会什么？AI 能把它放大多少倍？
dimensions.zh: 智 · 能力与 AI 素养

dimensions.companion_en: Listen first. Sleep, movement and friends count. In a crisis, refer to qualified help.
dimensions.companion_zh: 先听，后说。睡眠、运动、朋友都算数。遇到危机，转介专业帮助。
dimensions.question_en: Am I okay, and who is beside me?
dimensions.zh: 情 · 情绪、关系与身体

dimensions.companion_en: Every conversation ends with one written next step that can be checked.
dimensions.companion_zh: 每次对话结束，都有一个写下来的、可以检验的下一步。
dimensions.question_en: Which door is next, and what is the next step?
dimensions.question_zh: 下一扇门是哪扇？下一步是什么？

agenda.en: Welcome and why: from fearing AI to a calling
agenda.zh: 欢迎，为什么做这件事：从对 AI 的恐惧到呼召

agenda.en: The honeycomb in three levels: CEO, advisors, core, apprentices
agenda.zh: 三层讲清蜂巢模型：CEO、顾问、核心队员、学徒

agenda.en: Breakouts by school: draft your first cell (what you'd lead, whom you need)
agenda.zh: 按学校分组：写下你的第一个蜂房（你想当 CEO 的那件事，需要谁）

agenda.en: Share, and each person writes one checkable next step
agenda.zh: 分享，每人写下一个可检验的下一步

agenda.en: Optional closing prayer, for those who wish

events.china_en: In mainland China: Google Meet needs a connection that can reach Google.
events.china_zh: 中国大陆的朋友请注意：Google Meet 需要能访问谷歌的网络。
events.en: Alumni Honeycomb: first online meeting (cameras on, face to face)
events.why_en: The first weekend after Thanksgiving. Sunday morning in Beijing, Saturday afternoon/evening in the US.
events.why_zh: 感恩节周末之后的第一个周末。北京是周日上午，美国是周六下午/晚上。
events.zh: 校友蜂巢第一次线上见面（开摄像头，面对面）

roles.who_en: The one with the vision and the conviction. Recruits the team, owns the result. A student or an alumnus.
roles.who_zh: 有异象、有信念的那个人。招募队员，对结果负责。学生或校友都可以。

roles.who_en: Someone who has walked this road. An alumnus of this school or another; meets at least monthly.
roles.who_zh: 走过这条路的人。本校或外校校友，每月至少一次碰头。

roles.who_en: Peers like a Navy SEAL team, who make the thing happen with the CEO.
roles.who_zh: 像海豹突击队一样的同伴，和 CEO 一起把事情做成。

roles.who_en: A newcomer who learns by doing alongside. Next season they may be a CEO.
roles.who_zh: 跟着做、跟着学的后来者。下一季可能就是 CEO。

season.en: A season is about 3 months. Four years of college is about 12 seasons, 12 full turns of being coached and coaching others.
season.zh: 一季约 3 个月。大学四年约 12 季：12 次被辅导、也辅导别人的完整经历。

targets.why: Two full cells (CEO + 2-3 advisors + 2-3 core + 2-3 apprentices) meeting = the honeycomb is real, not a WeChat group.
Three people who held two different roles (e.g. CEO in one cell, apprentice in another) = the North Star moves.
A second school runs its own hive under the same charter = the federation exists, not just one club.
One cell in one school builds on a learning card from another school = the federation compounds, not just coexists.

strategy.tripwire: If T1 is below 1 on 2026-12-19, do not add a second school, a token, or any feature. Ask the people who stopped what stopped them, and build that.
